title: A highly magnified star at redshift 6.2

evidence.locator: abstract: z_phot = 6.2 ± 0.1, magnified by a factor of thousands by the foreground galaxy cluster WHL0137-08 (z = 0.566). Text: the star sits atop the lensing critical curve at RA, Dec = 01:37:23.232, -8:27:52.20 (J2000), designated WHL0137-LS; the Sunrise Arc exceeds 15 arcseconds.
